hero.title: Bitcoin rebounds to $82,000 as Trump rules out Iran strikes, oil drops
hero.description: Bitcoin rebounded to $82,000 as Trump ruled out an Iran strike before the midterms, while crypto security experts pushed back on “bunker mode” fears.

latest.title: Bitcoin rebounds to $82,000 as Trump rules out Iran strikes, oil drops

latest.title: Thailand finalizes rules paving way for Bitcoin, Ether ETFs
latest.description: The rules are set to take effect next week, allowing crypto ETFs to trade exclusively on the Stock Exchange of Thailand.

latest.title: U.S. East Asian envoy says investors are overpricing Taiwan conflict risk
latest.description: Investors are overestimating the risk of conflict across the Taiwan Strait, a U.S. diplomat says, playing up deterrence to keep Beijing from taking the island.

latest.title: Nvidia-backed Aussie AI firm Firmus withdraws historic IPO, citing market volatility
latest.description: Nvidia-backed Australian AI data center operator Firmus has withdrawn its planned IPO amid market volatility.

latest.title: Cantor Fitzgerald faces Senate Democrat’s questions over Tether ties
latest.description: The letter follows a report by the Democratic investigators last month alleging Tether’s USDT has become a key tool for Iran’s shadow banking network.

latest.title: Tokenization could unleash tens of billions of dollars in trapped capital, Nasdaq CEO says
latest.description: Nasdaq CEO Adena Friedman said tokenization could free up tens of billions of dollars in trapped capital.

latest.title: SpaceX deal to acquire spectrum license hammers shares of AT&T, Verizon and T-Mobile
latest.description: SpaceX agreed to purchase a nationwide spectrum portfolio as it to pushes its Starlink service deeper into the U.S. telecommunications market.

latest.title: China’s P2P stablecoin wallets surge 43x, Korea’s $450B crypto economy: Asia Express
latest.description: Despite ongoing bans, China has seen a big surge in peer-to-peer stablecoin use. New figures show South Korea’s $450B crypto economy is the largest in East Asia.

latest.title: AI Startup Manus Raises $500 Million After China Nixed Meta’s $2 Billion Acquisition
latest.description: Manus built a self-driving AI assistant before the hype, sold itself to Meta, then watched Beijing unwind the deal. Its first fresh money since: more than $500 million.

latest.title: Top Democrat among Senate investigators probes ties between Cantor Fitzgerald, Tether
latest.description: As Democrats steadily rise in their potential to take back a Senate majority, Senator Richard Blumenthal is digging into Tether's U.S. financial partnership.

latest.title: Nvidia, Oracle, CoreWeave and other AI stocks sink on OpenAI revenue report
latest.description: OpenAI has told investors that it hit roughly $50 billion in annualized revenue at the end of September, CNBC confirmed.

latest.title: Google Wants Gemini to Be Your Next Coworker—Complete With Its Own Email Address
latest.description: Google Cloud unveiled a single Gemini agent that takes goals instead of questions, works in the background for days, and can join a company as a staffer with its own inbox and calendar.

latest.title: America shut out Chinese EVs. Britain welcomed them — and now faces a difficult choice
latest.description: Britain faces a finely balanced choice over whether to follow the EU in imposing tariffs on Chinese EVs.

latest.title: Sports gambling seeps even deeper into Wall Street's world as hundreds of pro team ETFs emerge
latest.description: Sports teams are big businesses, but new exchange-traded funds that allow investors to bet on MLB and NHL team performance look more like gambling, experts say.

latest.title: Major League Baseball proposes shortening its regular season as it pushes for a salary cap
latest.description: Major League Baseball proposed a return to a shorter 154-game regular season schedule as it attempts to convince players to approve a salary cap.

latest.title: Ethereum Test Network Raises Block Limit to Over 3x Its Current Capacity
latest.description: Ethereum's Sepolia test network activated Glamsterdam on October 6 with a block gas limit near 200 million, over three times mainnet's 60 million.

latest.title: Why a Starbucks takeover of Chipotle would — and wouldn't — make sense for both companies
latest.description: Starbucks has reportedly been working with advisers on a takeover proposal for Chipotle, but a potential deal comes with pros and cons for investors.

latest.title: Treasury yields are lower after reaching multiyear highs, traders weigh latest bond auction
latest.description: Traders digested comments from a top Federal Reserve official while awaiting another long-dated bond auction.

latest.title: Treasury yields are 'really, really high' but can come down soon, Bessent's new advisor says
latest.description: The comments from David Zervos come after the 10-year and 30-year yields marched to 24-year highs in recent days.

latest.title: Costco's sales resilience is giving Cramer a reason to feel better about the stock
latest.description: Jim Cramer is feeling better about the wholesaler following its September report
